work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act names Bishop William Morris apostolic visitor of Mauritius on Slater's departure. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF11478; own dating clause LF11545–11548 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima tertia decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo. ,. Own provenance note LF11577 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
